versions.changelog:
- Added support and instructions for searching webtoons (manhwa, manhua) by genre and reading platform.
- Updated the description to include webtoons as a supported media type.
- Expanded usage guidance for presenting webtoon and platform-specific results.
- Removed legacy file: skill-card.md.

- Initial release of the find-anime skill.
- Search anime or manga by title, genre, year, or season.
- View what's airing this week or in upcoming seasons.
- Get detailed info and viewing/reading links for specific titles.
- Browse top-rated or popular titles by genre.
- No explicit (18+) content is listed.
- Easy page links included for each recommendation.
